posts.body:
I want to implement a debuff that is removed at battle end that gives the player less gold than what they normally would get.
I found this thread:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/obtain-less-gold.63496/
but it was for VX Ace, I tried using the formula on the thread in the enemy notetag replacing the conditional to isStateAffected to no luck.
I tried making a conditional in the troop event and one in the battle processing event but neither work, how should I go about this?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
The notes field don't just do things, they're for taking notes. Nothing you type in there matters unless you have a plugin coded to do so.
I Googled "rpg maker mv plugin gold drop" and this seems to do what you want:
Gold rate / Drop rate
